For albums with certifications, see [List of certified albums in South Korea](List_of_certified_albums_in_South_Korea "List of certified albums in South Korea").

This is a list of the best-selling albums of recorded music in South Korea. To appear on the list, the figure must have been published by a reliable source and the [album must have sold](Record_sales "Record sales") at least 1 million copies. As of March 2021, *[Map of the Soul: 7](Map_of_the_Soul%3A_7 "Map of the Soul: 7")* by South Korean boy band <BTS> is the best-selling album of all time in the country.[[3]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-3) [Kim Gun-mo](Kim_Gun-mo "Kim Gun-mo")'s 1995 studio album *[Wrongful Meeting](Wrongful_Meeting "Wrongful Meeting")* previously held the record as the best-selling South Korean album for 24 years, with an estimated 3.3 million copies sold—this includes figures based on illegal sales[[4]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-4)—until it was surpassed by BTS' *[Map of the Soul: Persona](Map_of_the_Soul%3A_Persona "Map of the Soul: Persona")* in 2019.[[5]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-5)[[6]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-Park_Si-soo-6)

The Korea Video & Record Distributors Association (KVRDA) published the first South Korean sales charts, tallying album sales figures for the month of August and the March-August semester, on September 10, 1998.[[7]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-7) Between 1999 and 2007, the Music Industry Association of Korea (MIAK) published monthly charts, with fifty chart positions and detailed sales for each album.[[8]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-8) Following the sharp decline of domestic music sales in the 21st century,[[9]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-9) the [Korea Music Content Association](Gaon_Music_Chart "Gaon Music Chart") (KMCA) introduced the [Gaon Album Chart](Gaon_Album_Chart "Gaon Album Chart") in February 2010, which included a detailed breakdown of online chart data.[[10]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-Gaon_start-10) The KMCA began awarding [sales certifications](Music_recording_certification "Music recording certification") for albums in April 2018—only albums released after January 1, 2018 are eligible.[[10]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-Gaon_start-10) Certifications are not included in this list, because the Gaon Music Chart publishes detailed album sales.

All albums that have sold over one million copies in South Korea are by Korean artists, with the exception of [Whitney Houston](Whitney_Houston "Whitney Houston")'s *[The Bodyguard](The_Bodyguard_(soundtrack) "The Bodyguard (soundtrack)")* (1992) and [Mariah Carey](Mariah_Carey "Mariah Carey")'s *[Music Box](Music_Box_(Mariah_Carey_album) "Music Box (Mariah Carey album)")* (1993). BTS is the act with the most million-selling albums, having twelve, followed by [Seventeen](Seventeen_(South_Korean_band) "Seventeen (South Korean band)"), with eight. In 2017, BTS' *[Love Yourself: Her](Love_Yourself%3A_Her "Love Yourself: Her")* became the first album released since 2001 to sell over 1 million copies,[[11]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-11)[[12]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-12) while in 2018 the band's *[Love Yourself: Answer](Love_Yourself%3A_Answer "Love Yourself: Answer")* became the first to sell over 2 million copies since 2000.[[13]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-13) In 2019, the band's *Map of the Soul: Persona* became the first album to sell over 3 million copies since 1997. This was followed by *Map of the Soul: 7*, which became the first album in chart history to surpass 4 and 5 million sales, in 2020 and 2022 respectively.[[14]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-14)[[15]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-15) Seventeen's *[FML](FML_(EP) "FML (EP)")* became the first album to sell over 6 million copies, in 2023.[[16]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-16) In 2013, the combined sales of <Exo>'s *[XOXO](XOXO_(Exo_album) "XOXO (Exo album)")* and its repackage exceeded 1 million copies,[[17]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-17) while in 2019 BTS became the first act to sell 1 million copies of both an album and its repackage, when [*Wings*](Wings_(BTS_album) "Wings (BTS album)") and *[You Never Walk Alone](You_Never_Walk_Alone "You Never Walk Alone")* each surpassed 1 million sales that year.

As of 2023, according to [Circle Chart](Circle_Chart "Circle Chart"),[[upper-alpha 1]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-19) BTS is the best-selling artist in South Korean history, having sold more than 40 million albums.[[19]](List_of_best-selling_albums_in_South_Korea#cite_note-20)

content:
Based on my research from Wikipedia, here are the **top four best-selling albums in South Korea** and their respective agencies/labels:

| Rank | Artist | Album | Year | Sales | Agency/Label |
|------|--------|-------|------|-------|--------------|
| 1 | **Seventeen** | *FML* | 2023 | 6,266,487 copies | **Pledis Entertainment** (subsidiary of HYBE Corporation since 2020) |
| 2 | **Stray Kids** | *5-Star* | 2023 | 5,242,486 copies | **JYP Entertainment** |
| 3 | **BTS** | *Map of the Soul: 7* | 2020 | 5,052,013 copies | **Big Hit Music** (now part of HYBE Corporation since 2021) |
| 4 | **BTS** | *Map of the Soul: Persona* | 2019 | 4,658,920 copies | **Big Hit Music** (now part of HYBE Corporation since 2021) |

### Key Notes:
- These albums all sold over 4 million copies in South Korea
- Three of the top four albums are by K-pop boy groups, with BTS appearing twice
- Pledis Entertainment (Seventeen's label) became a subsidiary of HYBE Corporation in May 2020
- Big Hit Music (BTS's label) was rebranded from Big Hit Entertainment and is now a label under HYBE Corporation (since March 2021)
- All data is based on the Circle Album Chart (formerly Gaon Album Chart), South Korea's official music sales chart
